description: Opens a dataset from this computer in a NeuroVue window, replacing the one it shows: a BIDS or other folder of NIfTI volumes, a single NIfTI volume (.nii, .nii.gz), a .nvbundle, or a NiiVue document (.nvd), such as one save wrote.

path.description: Absolute path to a dataset folder, a NIfTI volume, a .nvbundle or a .nvd, inside an allowed data root.

dataset.description: The dataset now open: its name, root folder, and each volume's id, label, shape and spacing, with the one shown marked.

useWhen: Show data that is on this computer, by its path, without asking the person to pick it.
Switch a window to another dataset.
Reopen a scene saved as a NiiVue document; save puts them in the Downloads folder.

avoidWhen.when: The window already shows a dataset and you want one more volume over it.
The file is a surface or a tract.

preconditions: The path is inside a folder agents may open: by default the person's home folder.
effects: Replaces the window's dataset and reloads the viewer: overlays, meshes, crosshair and plane start over.

duration.basis: A BIDS dataset of 20 runs on an Apple-silicon laptop; large 4D files take longer.

match.contains: outside the folders agents may open

failures.meaning: The path resolves, after following symlinks, outside the folders NeuroVue lets agents open.
failures.remedy: Ask the person to add the folder to "roots" in NeuroVue's mcp.json, or to open the file themselves. Retrying with the same path will not help.

failures.meaning: The path is relative; NeuroVue does not know which folder it is relative to.
Nothing exists at that path, or NeuroVue may not read it.
failures.remedy: Check the path; on macOS the person may need to give NeuroVue access to the folder.
